reference.author: Studio Daniel Maarleveld
reference.reinspection: Revisited the user-opened video and its moving poses after the correction: horizontal rows traverse a shared ribbon and lift into lettering. This differs from the earlier separate extruded glyph outlines. No reference code/media copied.

behavior: Construction Floating letters preserves the original separate solid glyph sculptures, including old patches with no Construction key
Construction Raised ribbon is one connected periodic height-field band with two boundary loops; spaces and counters remain part of the band
Horizontal rows continue across the entire band, raising at letter strokes and returning to its base; rows are local to the ribbon before camera projection
Drum and Ring, Scroll/Rock/Tumble, Manual/Timeline and exact loops all work; no machine Z from relief
Horizontal lines, Relief shoulder and Ribbon padding are scoped to the new mode; floating Arc/Contour slices remain intact and are inactive for the closed ribbon
Empty text leaves a plain band. Dense work is uniformly reduced or refused whole. No partial strip allocation/export.
Three new live 72 x 100 mm starters: Raised ribbon, Wave ribbon and Raised ring; the four Floating starters remain

validation.topology: One connected manifold band with exactly two boundary loops and no glyph holes/seam crack. Continuous horizontal rows share base and raised radii.
validation.coverage: Both shapes, all movements, loops/random access, O counter base, zero/empty relief, new controls, exact portable/Help parity, margins/framing, dense budgets, actual SVG and servo/bed-Z exports.

limits: Horizontal means along the unwrapped ribbon; perspective, wave and view roll can curve or tilt those rows on screen.

Relief is a graphic continuous surface; no collision simulation or machine-depth command.
